messages:
olivia: Morning all — quick GPU headroom check. APAC likely spike 11:00-13:00 UTC driven by customer batch-evals. Current pools: alpha 65% (estimated 80% once queued jobs start), beta 38%, gamma 12%. Autoscale will help but could be slow ramp. I propose a short, staggered pause of low-priority scheduled crons to keep p95 gen latency <300ms. Any concerns? :thinking:

reza: Can you share queued job counts / avg seq len so I can estimate extra GPUs if we don’t pause? Also will autoscale bump within the burst quota?

olivia: Queue depth ~220 jobs, avg seq ~1024 tokens. Back-of-envelope extra capacity = ~4-6 A100s to keep latency comfortable. Burst quota cap is 12 nodes for this region — if we hit that we will see throttling on new requests.

Proposal (staggered window): pause-group-1 (nightly-reports) 10:55-12:35 UTC, pause-group-2 (eval-sweep low-prio) 11:10-12:40 UTC. That staggers freeing of headroom instead of all at once. Config example for pause (ops-tool):

```
# ops-tool pause schedule
- service: nightly-reports
  action: pause
  from: "2026-03-17T10:55:00Z"
  to:   "2026-03-17T12:35:00Z"
- service: eval-sweep-low
  action: pause
  from: "2026-03-17T11:10:00Z"
  to:   "2026-03-17T12:40:00Z"
```

mike: I can take responsibility for pausing nightly-reports at 10:55 and unpausing at 12:35. Will update the runbook and leave a rollback marker in the PR. @olivia if you want me on manual swap I can step in.

anya: I can cover 11:30-13:30 for oncall if we need a swap. I'll also temporarily add a circuit-breaker for one heavy customer flow to reduce tail risk.

oncall-bot: Reminder: alert "pool-alpha p95 latency > 300ms" will fire at threshold — team will be paged if breached.

deploy-bot: Actioned: Paused svc-nightly-reports @2026-03-17T10:56:12Z by mike (reason: APAC surge mitigation).

olivia: Thanks everyone. If no objections I’ll proceed with these pauses. Plan B: if p95 still bad we route highest-tier customers to dedicated capacity and open a short-notice reserved pool. I’ll post metrics at 11:15 and 12:00. :thumbsup:

reza: :thumbsup: I’ll watch metrics and post a quick status at 11:05 and 11:45.

mike: Done — paused nightly-reports, added notes to ops-runbook and the incident playbook.
